breakdown.description: The inward normal pressure on the arc is replaced by a fixed vertical traction vector
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Apply a uniform vertical traction of (0, -20000) Pa (i.e., -20 kPa in the y-direction) on the arc boundary', which repeats the exact error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires treating the arc load as an inward pressure (t = -p*n with n the outward normal of the solid), meaning the traction direction varies along the arc following the boundary normal, not a fixed vertical vector.
